mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campus_clue ( clue_id, clue_title, clue_content, clue_source, source_platform, original_url, publish_time, discover_time, involved_department_id, involved_account, keywords, risk_level, school_relevance_score, school_relevance_reason, matched_school_terms, excluded_reason, topic_category, topic_sub_category, topic_reason, sentiment, language, clue_status, duplicate_key, remark, deleted, create_user_id, update_user_id ) VALUES ( #{clueId}, #{clueTitle}, #{clueContent}, #{clueSource}, #{sourcePlatform}, #{originalUrl}, #{publishTime}, #{discoverTime}, #{involvedDepartmentId}, #{involvedAccount}, #{keywords}, #{riskLevel}, #{schoolRelevanceScore}, #{schoolRelevanceReason}, #{matchedSchoolTerms}, #{excludedReason}, #{topicCategory}, #{topicSubCategory}, #{topicReason}, #{sentiment}, #{language}, #{clueStatus}, #{duplicateKey}, #{remark}, #{deleted}, #{createUserId}, #{updateUserId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE campus_clue SET risk_level = #{riskLevel}, judge_opinion = #{judgeOpinion}, judge_user_id = #{judgeUserId}, judge_time = NOW(), clue_status = 'judged', update_user_id = #{updateUserId} WHERE clue_id = #{clueId} AND deleted = 0 AND clue_status != 'archived' AND clue_status != 'converted' AND event_id IS NULL

UPDATE campus_clue SET sentiment = #{sentiment}, school_relevance_score = #{schoolRelevanceScore}, school_relevance_reason = #{schoolRelevanceReason}, matched_school_terms = #{matchedSchoolTerms},
excluded_reason = #{excludedReason},
topic_category = #{topicCategory}, topic_sub_category = #{topicSubCategory}, topic_reason = #{topicReason}, update_user_id = #{updateUserId} WHERE clue_id = #{clueId} AND deleted = 0 AND (clue_status IS NULL OR clue_status != 'archived')

UPDATE campus_clue SET clue_status = 'converted', event_id = #{eventId}, update_user_id = #{updateUserId} WHERE clue_id = #{clueId} AND deleted = 0 AND clue_status != 'archived' AND clue_status != 'converted' AND event_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM campus_clue WHERE clue_id = #{clueId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

choose.otherwise: AND ( clue_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR clue_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR involved_account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR matched_school_terms LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR topic_category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR topic_reason LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

choose.when: AND (sentiment IS NULL OR sentiment = '' OR LOWER(sentiment) = 'none' OR sentiment = '未知')
choose.otherwise: AND ( FIND_IN_SET(sentiment, #{sentiment}) > 0 OR (FIND_IN_SET('negative', #{sentiment}) > 0 AND (LOWER(sentiment) = 'negative' OR sentiment LIKE '%负%')) OR (FIND_IN_SET('neutral', #{sentiment}) > 0 AND (LOWER(sentiment) = 'neutral' OR sentiment LIKE '%中%')) OR (FIND_IN_SET('positive', #{sentiment}) > 0 AND (LOWER(sentiment) = 'positive' OR sentiment LIKE '%正%')) OR (FIND_IN_SET('none', #{sentiment}) > 0 AND (sentiment IS NULL OR sentiment = '' OR LOWER(sentiment) = 'none' OR sentiment = '未知')) OR (#{sentiment} = '负面' AND (sentiment LIKE '%负%' OR LOWER(sentiment) = 'negative')) OR (#{sentiment} = '中性' AND (sentiment LIKE '%中%' OR LOWER(sentiment) = 'neutral')) OR (#{sentiment} = '正面' AND (sentiment LIKE '%正%' OR LOWER(sentiment) = 'positive')) OR (#{sentiment} LIKE '%负%' AND LOWER(sentiment) = 'negative') OR (#{sentiment} LIKE '%中%' AND LOWER(sentiment) = 'neutral') OR (#{sentiment} LIKE '%正%' AND LOWER(sentiment) = 'positive') )

sql.if: AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM campus_clue c2 WHERE c2.duplicate_key = campus_clue.duplicate_key AND c2.id < campus_clue.id AND c2.deleted = 0 )

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0
ORDER BY publish_time DESC, id DESC ORDER BY sentiment DESC, id DESC ORDER BY id DESC ORDER BY id DESC ORDER BY school_relevance_score DESC, discover_time DESC, id DESC ORDER BY discover_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0
AND discover_time >= #{startTime}
AND discover_time < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY discover_time DESC, id DESC

otherwise.if: AND ( clue_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR clue_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR involved_account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR matched_school_terms LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR topic_category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR topic_reason LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

sql.if: AND COALESCE(publish_time, discover_time, create_time) < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

otherwise.if: AND ( c.clue_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.clue_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.involved_account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.matched_school_terms LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.topic_category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.topic_reason LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

sql.if: AND COALESCE(c.publish_time, c.discover_time, c.create_time) < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0
ORDER BY COALESCE(publish_time, discover_time, create_time) DESC, id DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(dates.d, '%m-%d') AS date, COALESCE(c.cnt, 0) AS clueCount, COALESCE(a.cnt, 0) AS alertCount FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(COALESCE(DATE(#{endTime}), CURDATE()), INTERVAL seq.seq DAY) AS d FROM ( SELECT 0 AS seq UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23 UNION ALL SELECT 24 UNION ALL SELECT 25 UNION ALL SELECT 26 UNION ALL SELECT 27 UNION ALL SELECT 28 UNION ALL SELECT 29 ) seq WHERE seq.seq < #{days} ) dates LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(COALESCE(publish_time, discover_time, create_time)) AS d, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0
GROUP BY DATE(COALESCE(publish_time, discover_time, create_time)) ) c ON dates.d = c.d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(COALESCE(c.publish_time, c.discover_time, c.create_time)) AS d, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM campus_alert a JOIN campus_clue c ON a.alert_source = 'clue' AND a.source_object_id = c.clue_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0
GROUP BY DATE(COALESCE(c.publish_time, c.discover_time, c.create_time)) ) a ON dates.d = a.d ORDER BY dates.d
SELECT clue_title as name, COUNT(*) as value FROM campus_clue GROUP BY clue_title LIMIT 10
SELECT source_platform as name, COUNT(*) as value FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY source_platform ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT CASE WHEN sentiment = 'positive' THEN '正面' WHEN sentiment = 'neutral' THEN '中性' WHEN sentiment = 'negative' THEN '负面' ELSE '未知' END as name, COUNT(*) as value FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY sentiment

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(source_platform, ''), '其它') as name, COUNT(*) as value FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(source_platform, ''), '其它') ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(clue_source, ''), '其它') as name, COUNT(*) as value FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(clue_source, ''), '其它') ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT keywords FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0 AND keywords IS NOT NULL AND keywords != ''

SELECT CONCAT( COALESCE(clue_title, ''), ' ', COALESCE(clue_content, ''), ' ', COALESCE(keywords, '') ) FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0 AND ( (clue_title IS NOT NULL AND clue_title != '') OR (clue_content IS NOT NULL AND clue_content != '') OR (keywords IS NOT NULL AND keywords != '') ) ORDER BY COALESCE(discover_time, create_time) DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DISTINCT clue_title FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0 AND clue_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') LIMIT 10

SELECT c.source_platform AS platform, TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.keywords, ',', num.n), ',', -1)) AS keyword, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM campus_clue c JOIN ( SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20 ) num ON CHAR_LENGTH(c.keywords) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(c.keywords, ',', '')) >= num.n - 1 WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.keywords IS NOT NULL AND c.keywords != '' AND c.discover_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY c.source_platform, keyword HAVING keyword != '' ORDER BY c.source_platform, cnt DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(dates.d, '%m-%d') AS date, COALESCE(c.cnt, 0) AS clueCount, COALESCE(a.cnt, 0) AS alertCount FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL seq.seq DAY) AS d FROM ( SELECT 0 AS seq UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23 UNION ALL SELECT 24 UNION ALL SELECT 25 UNION ALL SELECT 26 UNION ALL SELECT 27 UNION ALL SELECT 28 UNION ALL SELECT 29 ) seq WHERE seq.seq < #{days} ) dates LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(COALESCE(discover_time, create_time)) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(COALESCE(discover_time, create_time)) ) c ON dates.d = c.d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM campus_alert WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) a ON dates.d = a.d ORDER BY dates.d

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(dates.d, '%m-%d') AS date, COALESCE(c.cnt, 0) AS clueCount, COALESCE(a.cnt, 0) AS alertCount FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL seq.seq DAY) AS d FROM ( SELECT 0 AS seq UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23 UNION ALL SELECT 24 UNION ALL SELECT 25 UNION ALL SELECT 26 UNION ALL SELECT 27 UNION ALL SELECT 28 UNION ALL SELECT 29 ) seq WHERE seq.seq < #{days} ) dates LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(COALESCE(discover_time, create_time)) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0
AND ( clue_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR clue_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR involved_account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
GROUP BY DATE(COALESCE(discover_time, create_time)) ) c ON dates.d = c.d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM campus_alert WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) a ON dates.d = a.d ORDER BY dates.d

SELECT CASE WHEN sentiment = 'positive' THEN '正面' WHEN sentiment = 'neutral' THEN '中性' WHEN sentiment = 'negative' THEN '负面' ELSE '未知' END as name, COUNT(*) as value FROM campus_clue WHERE deleted = 0
AND ( clue_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR clue_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR involved_account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
GROUP BY sentiment

AND ( clue_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR clue_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR involved_account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
GROUP BY source_platform ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10
